function_v0.doc:
Enforce the threshold policy.

Validates that the number of authenticated signers meets the
configured threshold, records that authorization occurred and
emits an event.
function_v0.name: enforce

function_v0.doc: Install the threshold policy for a smart account.\n\nStores the threshold configuration for the given context rule.
function_v0.name: install

function_v0.doc: Uninstall the threshold policy for a smart account.\n\nRemoves the threshold configuration for the given context rule.
function_v0.name: uninstall

function_v0.doc: Get the current threshold for a smart account
function_v0.name: get_threshold

function_v0.doc: Set a new threshold for a smart account
function_v0.name: set_threshold

udt_union_v0.doc:
Context of a single authorized call performed by an address.

Custom account contracts that implement `__check_auth` special function
receive a list of `Context` values corresponding to all the calls that
need to be authorized.
udt_union_v0.name: Context

tuple_v0.doc: Contract that has a constructor with no arguments is created.
tuple_v0.name: CreateContractHostFn

tuple_v0.doc: Contract that has a constructor with 1 or more arguments is created.
tuple_v0.name: CreateContractWithCtorHostFn

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Authorization context of a single contract call.

This struct corresponds to a `require_auth_for_args` call for an address
from `contract` function with `fn_name` name and `args` arguments.
udt_struct_v0.name: ContractContext

udt_union_v0.doc: Contract executable used for creating a new contract and used in\n`CreateContractHostFnContext`.
udt_union_v0.name: ContractExecutable

udt_struct_v0.doc: Authorization context for `create_contract` host function that creates a\nnew contract on behalf of authorizer address.
udt_struct_v0.name: CreateContractHostFnContext

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Authorization context for `create_contract` host function that creates a
new contract on behalf of authorizer address.
This is the same as `CreateContractHostFnContext`, but also has
contract constructor arguments.
udt_struct_v0.name: CreateContractWithConstructorHostFnContext

udt_union_v0.doc: Represents different types of signers in the smart account system.
udt_union_v0.name: Signer

tuple_v0.doc: A delegated signer that uses built-in signature verification.
tuple_v0.name: Delegated

tuple_v0.doc: An external signer with custom verification logic.\nContains the verifier contract address and the public key data.
tuple_v0.name: External

udt_struct_v0.doc: A complete context rule defining authorization requirements.
udt_struct_v0.name: ContextRule

fields.doc: The type of context this rule applies to.
fields.name: context_type

fields.doc: Unique identifier for the context rule.
fields.name: id

fields.doc: Human-readable name for the context rule.
fields.name: name

fields.doc: List of policy contracts that must be satisfied.
fields.name: policies

fields.doc: Global registry IDs for each policy, positionally aligned with\n`policies`.
fields.name: policy_ids

fields.doc: Global registry IDs for each signer, positionally aligned with\n`signers`.
fields.name: signer_ids

fields.doc: List of signers authorized by this rule.
fields.name: signers

fields.doc: Optional expiration ledger sequence for the rule.
fields.name: valid_until

udt_union_v0.doc: Types of contexts that can be authorized by smart account rules.
udt_union_v0.name: ContextRuleType

void_v0.doc: Default rules that can authorize any context.
void_v0.name: Default

tuple_v0.doc: Rules specific to calling a particular contract.
tuple_v0.name: CallContract

tuple_v0.doc: Rules specific to creating a contract with a particular WASM hash.
tuple_v0.name: CreateContract
